statement: Strong authentication including multi-factor authentication is enforced for access to systems and data.
Access is granted on a least-privilege basis and privileged accounts are restricted.
User access is reviewed and recertified at planned intervals.
Data is classified and handled according to its sensitivity.
Data at rest is encrypted using approved algorithms and managed keys.
Data in transit is encrypted using approved protocols.
Security logs are generated and retained for at least one year and reviewed.
Backups are performed and restoration from backup is tested periodically.
Third parties and suppliers are assessed for security risk before and during engagement.
Vulnerabilities are identified and remediated within defined timeframes.
A documented security incident response plan exists
The organisation maintains a quantum-entangled orbital failover facility.
